minecolonies.config.citizenaidebugoverla: Show nearby citizens' AI states and planned paths for debugging.
minecolonies.config.citizenaidebugloggin: Log citizen AI and navigation diagnostics. Verbose; disable after investigating problems.
minecolonies.config.citizenaidebugcitize: Limit AI logs to these citizen name fragments (case insensitive) or exact UUIDs. Empty selects everyone. Path verbosity: 0 disables dumps, 1 summarizes searches, 2-10 include nodes.
minecolonies.config.workeraispeedmultipl: Worker AI decision cadence multiplier; larger values reduce waits between decisions.
minecolonies.config.miningspeedmultiplie: Mining speed multiplier, applied after tool and skill calculations.
minecolonies.config.builderminingcheckin: Ticks between the builder's mining progress checks.
minecolonies.config.builderverticalreach: Allow vertical construction within the active blueprint from nearby safe ground, matching the original builder's horizontal reach rule.
